messages:
maria: kicking off bring-up for heron-embed compact int4 on staging. ran an initial recall@k vs prod (bert-base-embed) on the wiki holdout — results look noisy, want a quick sanity check. attaching numbers below.

alex: can you paste the eval numbers (R@1/5/10) and the eval config?

maria: sure, pasted from the eval job output:```
model: heron-compact-int4
baseline: bert-base-embed
holdout: wiki-10k
metrics: recall@1=0.43, recall@5=0.61, recall@10=0.69
baseline recall@1=0.51, recall@5=0.68, recall@10=0.74
batch_size=64, seq_len=256, similarity=cosine
quant: per-channel asymmetric int4, outlier_clip=2.5
```

jia: those deltas are non-trivial at R@1. any chance quantization overflowed for low-variance dims? what was the calibration dataset? :thinking:

maria: used 10k random corpus slices from production wiki feed (same split as baseline). calibration used mean/std per-channel with percentile clipping.

luis: quick UMAP of embeddings shows tighter clusters but some entity clusters collapsed to a single centroid — looks like norm collapse on longer docs :eyes:

maria: here's the quick knn-drift output I ran:```
# run: python tools/knn_drift.py --ref bert-base-embed --cand heron-compact-int4 --k 10 --holdout wiki-10k
avg_nn_dist_ref=0.82
avg_nn_dist_cand=0.96
frac_misordered_pairs=0.12
```
suggests embeddings are sparser/higher distance, which explains recall drop.

aj: maybe try embedding norm rescale post-quant: `emb = emb / (1e-6 + norm(emb, p=2, dim=-1).unsqueeze(-1)) * target_norm` — target_norm from baseline median.

maria: good call. I'll run a quick post-quant rescale and re-eval. also scheduling an int8 symmetric run to compare.

ops-bot: embed-eval pipeline #2147 completed: status=success, duration=8m, artifact=gs://redwood-evals/2147/heron-int4/summary.json

alex: next steps proposal: 1) rescale and rerun wiki-10k; 2) run int8 symmetric with same calibration; 3) run a 100k longer-doc holdout (seq_len 1024) to stress long-doc behaviour; 4) generate UMAP screenshots and a small set of failure examples for product. If rescale fixes >80% of delta we can consider quant-aware calibration; else fallback to int8 for prod.

maria: assigning myself 1+2, jia will take 3, luis will handle visualization + collect 50 failure examples. pinging @jia @luis.

jia: got it — I'll queue the 100k job on dedicated staging pool later today.

luis: will export UMAP + example set to the shared drive, will include per-doc token counts.

maria: thanks all, I'll post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
